title: I Am Lucky!
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold): 'I Am Lucky!'. New words, comprehension, describing words (adjectives), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'I Am Lucky!': lucky, wings, tall, soft.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'I Am Lucky!' mean (lucky, wings, tall, soft); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A bird uses its ___ to fly.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word means the opposite of 'short'?
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: I am lucky to have a kind teacher.
The soft, white rabbit hopped away.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'I Am Lucky!' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'I Am Lucky!'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem says the child feels ___ to be who they are.
In the poem, the child feels ___ for all that they have.

exemplars: I am lucky to have a kind teacher.
The soft, white rabbit hopped away.

nodes.title: Describing Words (Adjectives)
nodes.teach_focus: A describing word (adjective) tells more about a thing: big, soft, green, happy.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses describing words (adjectives) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of describing words (adjectives).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word is a describing word?

bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The soft, brown rabbit hops away.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'I Am Lucky!'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'I Am Lucky!': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I am lucky to have a ___ family.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.
A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: I am lucky to have a kind teacher.
The soft, white rabbit hopped away.

items.prompt: Which word means the opposite of 'short'?
A bird uses its ___ to fly.
The poem says the child feels ___ to be who they are.
In the poem, the child feels ___ for all that they have.
Which word is a describing word?
